```{r}
#| label: els-ancova
#| include: false

els_var <- c("nar_ndw50_a", "con_ndw50_a")
els_label <- c(
  "Narrative NDW50",
  "Conversation NDW50"
)
els_covariates <- c("nar_totnumut_a", "con_totnumut_a")
names(els_label) = els_var
names(els_covariates) = els_var

# fit ANCOVA models
els_ancova <- lapply(
  els_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova(
    dataset = data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = els_label[x],
    covariates = els_covariates[x] |> unname()
  )
)
names(els_ancova) <- els_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova output
els_ancova_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(els_ancova),
    function(x) {
      els_ancova[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)

# Note: Plots will be added in a future iteration
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-els-ancova
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ELS - ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change,
#|    and between-group difference in changes. {data_caption}")

els_ancova_ft <- els_ancova_summary |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_p = "p-value"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences"),
    colwidths = c(1, 7, 7, 5)
  ) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 8, 15), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

els_ancova_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-els-ancova-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "ELS - Forest plot showing between-group differences in changes. {data_caption_els}")

els_ancova_list <- lapply(els_ancova, function(x) list("fit" = x$fit$fit))

plot_ancova_forest(
  obj = els_ancova_list,
  labels = els_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1
)
```
